name: Date picker slicer to set relative and manual date ranges
description: Adds a **date picker** mode for date slicers so authors can pick a relative default range (e.g., “last full month”) that automatically rolls forward as time passes when published, without authors having to update the report each period. Report viewers can override it to filter to other relative ranges or any manual date range.

result.nameEs: Segmentación de selector de fechas con rangos relativos y manuales
